WITH table1 AS (

            master_log.bpp_id,
            master_log.order_id,
            master_log.transaction_id,
            master_log.date,
            master_log.order_created_at,
            master_log.cancellation_code,
            master_log.retail_order_id,
            master_log.pick_up_pincode,
            master_log.delivery_pincode,
            master_log.retail_category,
            master_log.shipment_type,
            master_log.provider_name,
                CASE
                    WHEN master_log.f_agent_assigned_at_date IS NULL THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END AS assigned,
            master_log.cancelled_date,
            master_log.picked_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN master_log.delivered_date IS NULL AND master_log.cancelled_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Cancelled'::character varying
                    WHEN master_log.delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND master_log.cancelled_date IS NULL THEN 'Completed'::character varying
                    ELSE master_log.latest_order_status
                END AS order_status,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY (COALESCE(master_log.retail_order_id, master_log.order_id)) ORDER BY master_log.order_created_at DESC) AS dedup,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY master_log.order_id, master_log.transaction_id, master_log.bap_id, master_log.bpp_id, master_log.order_created_at ORDER BY master_log.order_created_at DESC) AS rn_order
           FROM logistics.master_log
          WHERE master_log.date >= (date(now()) - '30 days'::interval day) AND master_log.drop_row = 0
        )

    t1.bpp_id,
    t1.order_id,
    t1.retail_order_id,

    t1.date,
    t1.order_created_at,
    t1.cancellation_code,
    t1.order_status AS latest_order_status,
        CASE

    t1.cancelled_date,

    t1.rn_order
   FROM table1 t1

    enriched_data.month_value,
    enriched_data.seller_state,
    'AGG'::text AS seller_district,
    enriched_data.category,
    'AGG'::text AS sub_category,
    enriched_data.seller_state_code,
    count(DISTINCT enriched_data.provider_key) AS total_sellers
   FROM enriched_data
  GROUP BY enriched_data.year_value, enriched_data.month_value, enriched_data.seller_state, enriched_data.category, enriched_data.seller_state_code
  ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6;
